reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000565 (the melody read from 000565a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells Gioachino Rossini (ascribed) as “ascr. to, Gioacchinno A. Rossini”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. Gioachino Rossini (ascribed)'s dates (1792–1868) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Rossini_GA (Rossini, Gioacchino, 1792-1868; the person CCEH's 'ascr. to, Gioacchinno A. Rossini' on MANOAH links to, https://hymnary.org/hymn/CCEH/565); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gioachino_Rossini (29 February 1792 - 13 November 1868); hymnals on https://hymnary.org/tune/manoah_greatorex print 'Gioacchino A. Rossini, 1792-1868'. CCEH misspells Gioachino and its 'ascr. to,' is an ascription, not a name; CCEH's page gives none. CCEH's page spells Franz Joseph Haydn (ascribed) as “ascr. to, Franz Joseph Haydn”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. Franz Joseph Haydn (ascribed)'s dates (1732–1809) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Haydn_FranzJoseph (Haydn, Joseph, 1732-1809; the person CCEH's 'ascr. to, Franz Joseph Haydn' on MANOAH links to, https://hymnary.org/hymn/CCEH/565); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joseph_Haydn (31 March 1732 - 31 May 1809). CCEH's 'ascr. to,' is an ascription, not a name; https://hymnary.org/tune/manoah_greatorex says MANOAH was first published in Greatorex's Collection, 1851; CCEH's page gives none. George Holden has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1840, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000565a.nwc).
